objectives.text: Implement a given repository interface with an in-memory HashMap store that calling code uses only through the interface
Wire Javalin routes to a service and the repository through constructors so that a request flows end to end and returns JSON
Return 400 for invalid input and 404 for a missing resource with JSON error bodies, mapping a custom exception with a Javalin exception handler
